alt: A paved street with a stately stone frontage on the left, a green square ahead and a tower district on the horizon.
A lakeside promenade with reeds and a bench at the water and the plan of the upper city hanging overhead.
Copper-crowned towers and spires seen from above, with megaframe ribs and the far side of the curved world beyond.
A mid-rise street with a bike lane, terraced frontages and the city curving up into the distance.
A lakeside path with a resident walking, towers across the water and the upper city overhead.
A wide aerial view along the rotor: parkland and blocks below, megaframe towers and the curved city rising ahead.
A narrow street between tall arched stone frontages running into the dense center of a district.
A paved lakeside plaza with a resident at the water's edge, reeds, trees and the city rising across the lake.
A field of crowned towers and spires from above, with megaframe ribs climbing toward the sky.
A tank farm of horizontal white vessels and spheres on a lattice deck inside the open truss of the industrial rotor.
A cargo tug carrying a white pod with orange bands along a rail, with the lattice trusses of the industrial rotor around it.
A domed stone market hall behind a columned portico with a name board, across a plaza in a dense civic quarter.
A stone hall with a columned portico and name board seen from its side, with gate towers and a vaulted roof above.
A columned portico with a pediment and name board on a street of stone civic frontages, with people walking below.
Detached villas on wide lawns with hedges and flowering trees, with the megaframe curving overhead in the distance.
A district of villas in gardens along a curving street seen from above, with a lake and parkland beyond.
